title: The Ask button is the design's hero button: a violet spectrum pill that sheens on hover
goal: The Ask button in the window's title bar looks like the design language's hero button: a filled blue-to-violet gradient pill with a soft violet glow, white sparkle, Ask and the shortcut. On hover the gradient widens toward pink, the glow grows and a single light sheen sweeps across it once. Pressing keeps the colour. Today it is a plain dark glass pill that looks like every other control.
notes:
The user, 2026-10-24: 'the ask button in the app does not match the design. We should have a hero button for ask, which has a nice sheen animation on hover as shown in the design language, but the button on the app mismatches.' Design picture: queue/audits/2026-10-24-user-ask-hero-design.png. App today: queue/audits/2026-10-24-user-ask-button-app.png.

Spec: docs/design/mocks/shared/components/button.css:107-185 (.btn.hero / .pill.ai): --hero-1 #6E8BFF, --hero-2 #c56cff, --hero-3 #ff7ab8; rest gradient 120deg hero-1 to hero-2; inset top highlight rgba(255,255,255,.4); glow 0 6px 16px -6px violet 60%; hover adds ::before gradient hero-1 -12%, hero-2 46%, hero-3 112% at opacity 1 over .2s, glow-hi 0 8px 22px -6px 66%, highlight .58; ::after sheen 55% wide band rgba(255,255,255,.5) swept translateX 0 to 260% over .66s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.3,1), fading in by 22%. Pressed: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(38,16,72,.34) + small glow. The comment there explains the earlier web bug where hover wiped the gradient to grey; do not reproduce it in SwiftUI.

App: Sources/Photonz/Agent/AskViews.swift:11-44 AskTitlebarButton uses .buttonStyle(.plain) + .glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: .capsule), fixed width 76 (static let width, probably used by the title bar layout: grep AskTitlebarButton.width before changing it). Build a reusable HeroButtonStyle (one per surface, Ask only, per the CSS comment) rather than inlining. Glass under a filled gradient is wrong: an opaque fill has no backdrop (CSS turns backdrop-filter off for the same reason). Clip the sheen to the capsule. The composer's own send button (AskViews.swift ~92, .borderedProminent) is a second Ask control on screen; the spec says one hero per surface, so leave it as is unless the runner judges otherwise and logs why.

Related: queue/tasks/p1-high/on-a-video-the-ask-button-never-sits-on-top-of-t.json touches the same button's placement; do not undo it.
acceptance: At rest the title bar Ask button is a capsule filled with a 120 degree gradient from #6E8BFF to #c56cff, white label and sparkle, a top inner highlight and a violet glow underneath, matching docs/design/mocks/shared/components/button.css .btn.hero; sampled pixel colours at the left and right ends of the pill are within a small tolerance of the two stops, MEASURED and written in the audit

On hover a wider blue, violet, pink gradient cross-fades in (about 0.2s), the glow grows, and one sheen sweeps left to right in about 0.66s and does not repeat while the pointer stays; the hover never turns the pill grey or dark
Pressed keeps the gradient and tucks the glow in; keyboard focus shows a violet ring
The shortcut text stays legible on the gradient (contrast measured in the audit), and the video case that hides the shortcut still lays out correctly
The button is sized to its content like the design (sparkle, Ask, shortcut with comfortable padding), not clipped by the old fixed 76pt width; title bar neighbours do not overlap
The hover animation runs on the GPU at 60fps with no layout work per frame; Reduce Motion skips the sweep but keeps the colour change
Try path: open any picture at Next defaults, look at the top right of the title bar, hover Ask, press it

Audit under queue/audits/ with the design picture and the app side by side at rest, hovered mid-sweep and pressed, plus a short reel (GIF or MP4) and contact sheet of the hover sheen; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not
